episode.title: ICE Allegedly Shot Someone. Texas Let Him Go
episode.description:
Extraditing someone who was arrested in one state for a crime committed in another state is an extremely routine process—or at least it was. But an ICE officer charged in a shooting in Minnesota was arrested in Texas and, rather than being sent to Minnesota for trial, he was simply released 90 days later.


Guest: Quinta Jurecic, staff writer at The Atlantic.
